mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.file_name, t.file_path, t.subject_id, s.subject_name, t.status, t.block_count, t.imported_count, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.remark from edu_qb_import_task t left join edu_subject s on s.subject_id = t.subject_id
